judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Opens mid-thought ('Actually, business has fallen off'), plain merchant patter with 'lad', a flat 50,000 gold price and a cheery 'stay out of [Person]'s way' sign-off: the loose, slightly clumsy NPC voice of the campaign's side vendors. Nothing over-crafted gives it away; the doubled '[Person]' warnings are the only faint tell of a pastiche.
